note: Per-file ceiling on bare `os.O_NOFOLLOW` / `os.O_DIRECTORY` / `os.O_NONBLOCK` references under loopx/. A ceiling is a maximum, not a target: the guard fails when a file exceeds it or a new file appears, and accepts a lower measurement, so retiring one of these sites needs no edit here. Lower or drop an entry whenever a file is fixed, so the ceiling does not describe an older tree than the code.
